scope: docs/design/sysexts.md 'When a sysext update takes effect'
correction: Believed that `updex features disable --now` reloads PID 1 only when a sysext that stays merged sets EXTENSION_RELOAD_MANAGER=1, so that PID 1 keeps the removed units loaded after the last disable. updex runs a plain `systemd-sysext unmerge` first; unmerge reads the key of the extensions merged before it unmounts, so the key of the sysext to remove makes the unmerge reload PID 1. Only a running unit of the removed sysext stays loaded, until it stops or the host reboots.
evidence: updex v2.1.3 updex/features.go L600-609 (Unmerge before file removal) and sysext/runner.go L156-158 (`systemd-sysext unmerge`, no --no-reload); systemd v262 src/sysext/sysext.c unmerge() L1915-1950 calls get_extension_release_metadata() before the unmerge fork and daemon_reload() after it; owner review T619
